name: Outcrawl
description: Search the web with the results already read, scrape and crawl pages into clean markdown or JSON, and hand a browser task to an agent.

disclosure: Tasks you connect can search the web, scrape and crawl pages, and run browser agents through Outcrawl, and pass what they read to their model.
Requests use the credits of the Outcrawl workspace that owns the key.
Connect checks the key with Outcrawl before saving it. The key stays on this Mac, readable only by the Outcrawl interface.
